updates.title: Introducing email action in company and custom object workflows
updates.content:
**Email Actions in Company & Custom Object Workflows**

Automated emails are coming to Company and Custom Object workflows — no more limiting this capability to contact-based workflows alone.

**What's coming:**

- Send automated emails directly from workflows built on Company records or any Custom Object
- Target associated contacts without adding extra workflow logic or triggering processes manually
- Choose which associated contacts receive the email — earliest, most recent, or all
- Select up to 10 association labels per email action, with built-in deduplication so no contact receives the same email twice
- Supports a wide range of business processes that go beyond standard contact workflows

This is currently in development and will be available in Kayan.ai soon.

updates.title: Social Planner: Post Sync for LinkedIn & TikTok (Beta)
updates.content:
**Social Planner: Post Sync for LinkedIn & TikTok (Beta) — Coming Soon**

Post Sync for LinkedIn and TikTok is coming to Kayan's Social Planner, giving you a unified view of your published content history alongside your scheduled posts — no manual imports required.

**What's coming:**

- **LinkedIn Post Sync** — Pull your published LinkedIn Organization Page posts directly into the Social Planner; view historical content and track reactions, comments, and shares alongside your content calendar
- **TikTok Post Sync** — Import published TikTok videos (Personal and Business accounts supported) and monitor likes, comments, shares, and views from one place
- **Automatic daily metric refresh** — Engagement data for both platforms updates every 24 hours, keeping your analytics current within platform API limits
- **Unified publishing calendar** — Manage historical and scheduled content across LinkedIn and TikTok alongside your other connected social accounts

**Good to know before it launches:**

- LinkedIn sync supports Organization Pages only — personal profiles are not supported due to API limitations
- PDF, Event, Poll, and Article post types will sync but won't support in-app previews
- TikTok videos play via TikTok's hosted player; cloning synced videos into new posts is not supported
- Sync is one-way — posts deleted on LinkedIn or TikTok will remain visible in the Social Planner
- Mentions, tagged users, hashtag details, location tags, and music metadata are unavailable due to platform API restrictions

This feature is currently in Beta. Full availability and setup instructions will be shared on release.

updates.title: Make Your Sites AI-Ready with llms.txt
updates.content:
**Make Your Sites AI-Ready with llms.txt**

You can now configure and manage an `llms.txt` file for each of your domains directly inside Kayan. Once saved, your file is served automatically at `https://<domain>/llms.txt` — no extra hosting or setup required.

**What's new:**
- Native hosting of your `llms.txt` as a clean Markdown map at your domain root
- In-platform editing — add and update content without touching external tools
- Per-domain control so each connected domain can have its own tailored file
- Passes Google PageSpeed Agentic Browsing checks out of the box, supporting AI search visibility (AEO/GEO)

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Sites** and open **Settings → Domains**
2. Select the domain you want to configure and open its settings modal
3. Scroll to the **llms.txt** section
4. Add or edit your site map content in Markdown
5. Save — your file publishes instantly to `https://<domain>/llms.txt`

updates.title: 📈 Rebuilt Course Progress Analytics
updates.content:
**Rebuilt Course Progress Analytics** *(Coming Soon)*

A fully rebuilt analytics experience for your courses is on the way. Track how learners move through your content, spot drop-offs early, and get a clearer picture of engagement — all from one place.

**What's coming:**

- Unified analytics dashboard with filters by course and enrollment date
- Key metrics: Completion Rate, Average Progress, and Time to Complete — with period-over-period comparisons
- Learner Journey Funnel showing progression from Enrolled → Started → Completed
- Member Progress Table with enrollment, activity, completion, and session-level detail

updates.title: Goal Action: Now with Support for User Replies!
updates.content:
**Goal Action: Trigger on Team Member Reply**

Automations can now detect when a team member replies to a contact and use that as a Goal event — immediately halting or redirecting the automation the moment human engagement begins.

**What's new:**
- "User Replied" is now a supported Goal event inside Kayan Automations
- When a team member sends a reply through any connected conversation channel, the contact jumps directly to the Goal step — skipping all intermediate actions
- Prevents contacts from receiving automated follow-ups after a real conversation has started
- Works across nurture sequences, support workflows, and any automation where human handoff matters

**How to set it up:**
1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and select the workflow you want to update
2. Add a **Goal** action at the point where human engagement should take over
3. Set the goal event to **User Replied**
4. Configure any actions that should run once the Goal is reached (e.g. move to a pipeline stage, add a tag, end the sequence)
5. Save and publish the workflow

**Notes:**
- The Goal triggers only when a team member sends the reply — not the contact
- Contacts skip all steps between their current position and the Goal step instantly
- Best used at the end of nurture sequences or before any actions that would create duplicate outreach

updates.title: Wait Step: Now with Support for User Replies!
updates.content:
**Wait Step Now Supports User Reply as a Wait Condition**

The Wait step in Kayan Automations now supports "User Replied" as a wait condition — letting you pause a workflow until a team member responds to a conversation, not just until a contact replies.

**What's new:**
- New wait condition: pause workflow execution until a user (team member) sends a reply in the conversation
- Optional timeout setting — if no reply is sent within your defined window, the workflow moves forward automatically
- On timeout, route contacts through escalation logic: supervisor alerts, conversation reassignments, task creation, or reminders
- If a user replies before the timeout, the workflow resumes immediately
- Works without a timeout configured — workflow simply waits indefinitely until a user reply is detected

**How to set it up:**

1. Open your workflow in the Kayan Automations tab and add a **Wait** step at the point where a team member response is expected.
2. Set the wait condition to **User Replied**.
3. Optionally define a timeout duration (e.g. 15 or 30 minutes) to cap the wait window.
4. Configure the path for when a reply is received, then configure a separate path for when the timeout expires — add escalation actions like notifications, reassignments, or task creation on the timeout branch.
5. Save and publish your workflow.

**Good for:** first-response SLA enforcement, sales lead response tracking, support escalation workflows, and internal response-time automations.

updates.title: Workflow Trigger: User Replied
updates.content:
**New Trigger: User Replied**

Automate actions the moment a team member responds to a contact — no more waiting on customer activity to move things forward.

**What's new:**
- A new automation trigger fires whenever a team member sends a reply to a contact
- Works across supported conversation channels
- Supports trigger filters so you control exactly when the automation runs
- Pairs with any follow-up actions: tagging, stage updates, internal notifications, task creation, assignments, and more

**How to set it up:**
1. Go to the **Automations** tab in your Kayan dashboard and open or create a workflow
2. Add the **User Replied** trigger
3. Configure any filters to narrow when the workflow should fire
4. Publish the workflow — it will run automatically each time a team member sends a reply

**Example use cases:**
- A rep replies to a new lead's SMS → opportunity stage updates to *Contacted* and the sales manager gets notified
- A support agent replies to a customer email → a *Support Responded* tag is applied and a 48-hour follow-up task is created

**Note:** This trigger activates on team member replies only, not incoming customer messages. Use it to build automations that respond to what your team does, not just what your contacts do.

updates.title: 💳 Services (v2): Payment Enhancements
updates.content:
**Services Payments: More Flexibility at Checkout**

Checkout for bookable services now supports flexible payment options, smarter deposit calculations, and better Buy Now, Pay Later compatibility.

**What's new:**

- **Deposit or full payment choice** — You can now enable an option that lets customers choose at checkout whether to pay a deposit or the full amount. Requires online payments to be active and a deposit configured on the service.
- **BNPL on full amounts** — Customers using Buy Now, Pay Later can now finance the complete service cost, not just the deposit, for a smoother booking experience.
- **Smarter percentage-based deposits** — Deposit amounts are now calculated against the final payable amount after discounts, add-ons, and taxes are applied. If a coupon is added, removed, or changed during checkout, the deposit recalculates in real time.
- **Flat deposits unchanged** — Fixed deposit amounts continue to work exactly as before.

---

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Services → Settings → Payment Settings**.
2. Set the payment mode to **Online Payment**.
3. Toggle on **Allow Deposit or Full Payment Choice**.
4. Save your changes.

Once enabled, customers booking services with a deposit configured will see both payment options at checkout.

updates.title: 🗓️ Buffer Time is Now Visible in Calendar Day & Week Views
updates.content:
**Buffer Time Now Visible in Day & Week Calendar Views**

Pre- and post-buffer times are now displayed directly in your Day and Week calendar views, giving you a clearer picture of how your schedule is spaced without changing how bookings work.

**What's new:**
- Buffer periods appear as distinct visual blocks before and after appointments in both Day and Week views
- Buffers are clearly differentiated from actual appointments so your schedule is easy to read at a glance
- Visibility applies across all calendar filters — by staff member, service, or category/group

**How to set it up:**
1. Open the **Calendar** section in your Kayan dashboard
2. Switch to **Day** or **Week** view
3. Enable the **Show buffer time** toggle
4. Buffer periods will appear highlighted around your appointments across all active filters

updates.title: WhatsApp statistics in Workflows
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Message Statistics in Automations**

Track the full delivery lifecycle of your WhatsApp messages directly inside your automation — no need to jump between tools.

**What's new**

- **Full delivery tracking:** Monitor total sent, pending, delivered, read, and failed counts for any WhatsApp action inside an automation, using the same status data reported back by Meta.
- **Custom date ranges:** Filter statistics by a specific time window to evaluate performance for a particular campaign or send period.
- **Message-level detail:** Open any individual message to view recipient information and precise delivery timestamps.
- **Export:** Download your statistics for external analysis or reporting.
- **Live refresh:** Update message statuses on demand with a refresh button — no full page reload required.

**How to set it up**

1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and select the automation containing a WhatsApp action.
2. Click on the WhatsApp action, then select **Statistics**.
3. Use the date range selector to define your reporting window.
4. Click into any individual message to view recipient and timestamp details.
5. Select **Open All Statistics**, then click **Export** to download the data.

WhatsApp delivery isn't guaranteed — messages can sit pending, fail, or go unread. Having delivered, read, and failed counts surfaced at the automation level means you can catch delivery drops or failure spikes at the source and export the detail when you need to investigate or report.

updates.title: WhatsApp: AI template generator (compliant, on-brand, fast)
updates.content:
**WhatsApp: AI Template Generator**

Generate compliant, ready-to-submit WhatsApp message templates from a plain description — no field-by-field building required.

**What's new**

- **AI drafting from a description:** Describe your use case and audience (e.g. "payment reminder for retail customers") and the AI drafts a complete template with personalisation variables already in place.
- **Auto-categorisation:** The AI classifies each draft as Utility, Marketing, or Authentication — aligned with Meta's own categories — so your template is set up correctly before it ever reaches review.
- **Inline validation:** Get real-time recommendations on length, formatting, and policy fit as you draft, catching issues before submission rather than after a rejection.
- **Fully editable before submit:** Adjust copy, variables, and CTAs however you need, then submit to Meta for approval when it's ready.

**Why it matters**

Meta applies different rules by template category — Utility templates, for example, aren't subject to the same per-user frequency limits as Marketing templates. Getting categorisation and formatting right up front means fewer rejections and no surprises at send time.

**How to set it up**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **WhatsApp → Templates** and select **Create Template → AI Template**.
2. Enter a description of your use case and target audience.
3. Review the AI-generated draft, its assigned category, and any validation hints.
4. Edit copy, variables, or CTAs as needed.
5. Submit to Meta for approval.

updates.title: WhatsApp template management: a full UX revamp
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Template Management: Full UX Overhaul**

Managing WhatsApp templates at scale just got significantly easier. The entire template and folder experience has been rebuilt — faster navigation, real folder structure, filtering, sorting, and flexible reorganization, all in a cleaner interface.

**What's new**

- **One-click refresh** — Update your template list and approval statuses in place without reloading the page. You stay exactly where you are.
- **Real folder navigation** — Open a folder and work inside it like a true directory. Templates and subfolders are scoped to the folder you're in, so nested organization is finally practical.
- **Template location visibility** — The templates list now shows which folder each template lives in, so your library structure is always clear at a glance.
- **Filters** — Narrow templates by Status, Language, Last Edited, and Category. No more scrolling through hundreds of templates to find the right one.
- **Sorting** — Order your list by Template Name, Language, Category, Last Edited, or Status.
- **Flexible reorganization** — Move templates between folders, nest folders inside others, or pull them back up to a parent level. Restructure freely as your needs change.
- **Refreshed interface** — Both the templates and folders screens have been rebuilt to match current design standards — cleaner, faster, more structured.

**How to set it up**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Messaging → WhatsApp Templates**.
2. Use the new **filter and sort controls** at the top of the template list to narrow or reorder your view.
3. Click into any folder to enter it directly and see only its contents.
4. To move a template or folder, select it and use the **Move** option to place it wherever it belongs.
5. Hit the **Refresh** button anytime to pull the latest Meta approval statuses without leaving your current view.

updates.title: WhatsApp Templates: Cleaner Selection, RTL Authoring, and Compliance Visibility
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Templates: Cleaner Selection, RTL Authoring, and Compliance Visibility**

WhatsApp template management in Kayan is now more reliable and transparent — fewer failed sends, faster pickers, and native right-to-left authoring built directly into your workflow.

**What's new**

- **Approved templates only:** Every template dropdown — in Conversations, Bulk Actions, and Automation WhatsApp steps — now shows only approved templates. You'll no longer be able to select a template that would silently fail at send time.
- **Faster template loading:** Dropdowns fetch only the data they need, so template pickers load quicker across all screens, including heavier, data-intensive views.
- **Native RTL authoring:** Create and edit Arabic, Urdu, and Hebrew templates directly in Kayan's template editor. No more drafting externally and pasting in. Works alongside the AI template generator for faster RTL creation.
- **Compliance visibility:** Meta compliance issues are surfaced before a send fails, so you know what's blocking a template before it causes a problem.
- **Phone Numbers tab fixes:** The WhatsApp Phone Numbers tab now scrolls cleanly and paginates correctly — no more overflow issues on smaller screens or long lists.

**How to set it up**

1. Go to **Kayan dashboard → Messaging → WhatsApp Templates**.
2. Open any existing template or create a new one — RTL language input is supported directly in the text fields.
3. When building automations, open the **Kayan Automations tab**, add a WhatsApp action, and open the template picker — only approved templates will appear.
4. Check the **Phone Numbers** tab to review connected numbers with the improved scroll and pagination.

No configuration required. All changes are live across your existing workflows and send surfaces.

updates.title: Smarter, Customizable Profile & Business Cards
updates.content:
**Smarter, Customizable Profile & Business Cards**

Your digital business card just got a significant upgrade — modernized designs, deeper personalization, and built-in tools to capture and track leads automatically.

**What's New**

- **Refreshed card designs** — Profile and Business Cards have a cleaner, more professional look out of the box
- **Default "Save Contact" button** — visitors can save your contact info to their device in one tap, no extra setup required
- **Cover images** — upload your own or choose from pre-designed templates
- **Custom color palette** — control background, text, icons, buttons, and button text individually
- **Minimalist view toggle** — hide icon labels for a cleaner card layout
- **Custom links** — add websites, booking links, portfolios, social profiles, or landing pages, each with an assigned icon via the built-in Icon Picker
- **Exchange Contact forms** — collect visitor info directly from your card using a new or existing form; submissions automatically create a new contact in your CRM with the lead source logged
- **Editable CTA text** — rename the contact exchange button to match your brand
- **Smart automation toggles** — optionally auto-display the contact form on card open, or auto-download your contact info to the visitor's device on arrival

---

**How to set it up**

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to **QR Code Builder**
2. Select or create a Profile or Business Card
3. Apply your cover image, color palette, and toggle minimalist view if preferred
4. Add custom links and assign icons using the Icon Picker
5. Configure your Exchange Contact form — build a new one or select an existing form
6. Set your CTA button text and enable any automation toggles you want
7. Publish and share your updated card

> **Note:** Existing Profile and Business Cards won't update automatically — you'll need to open each one and apply the new settings manually.

updates.title: Ad Manager: Opportunity Score for Meta Campaigns
updates.content:
**Ad Manager: Opportunity Score for Meta Campaigns**

Before you publish a Meta ad campaign, Kayan now shows you an Opportunity Score — a readiness rating that flags setup gaps and points you directly to where you can fix them.

**What's new:**

- **Pre-publish readiness score** — See a percentage score (rated Low, Medium, or High) on the campaign Review screen before going live
- **Improvement suggestions across four areas:**
  - *Audience* — flags if targeting is too narrow, too broad, or incomplete
  - *Budget* — identifies if spend settings may limit delivery or learning
  - *Creative* — reviews ad content, media, CTAs, and destination links
  - *Tracking* — checks whether conversion tracking is configured
- **Click-to-fix navigation** — each recommendation links directly to the relevant section of the campaign builder so you can make updates without hunting through settings
- **Prioritised guidance** — the score panel surfaces the highest-impact fixes first

**A few things to note:**
- Opportunity Score is currently available for Meta campaigns only
- It's a guidance tool — it does not guarantee performance or make changes automatically
- You decide which recommendations to act on

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open **Ad Manager** in your Kayan dashboard and create or edit a Meta campaign
2. Complete your campaign setup
3. Proceed to the **Review** screen
4. Check your **Opportunity Score** in the score panel
5. Review the suggestions listed and click any recommendation to jump directly to that section
6. Make your updates, return to the Review screen, and publish when ready

updates.title: 📲 SMS Notifications Now Available for Rentals
updates.content:
**SMS Notifications Now Available for Rental Bookings**

You can now send SMS notifications for rental bookings directly from Kayan. Set up confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups that reach contacts and your team in real time — no manual outreach needed.

**What's new:**
- SMS support across all rental booking events: unconfirmed, booked, canceled, rescheduled, reminder, and follow-up
- Choose recipients per notification — send to the contact, your business, or both
- Set separate SMS templates for contacts vs. your business so each party gets the right message
- Default templates included for every notification type, with full customization options or the ability to pull from existing templates in your account
- Test any SMS before it goes live using the built-in Send Test SMS option

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Calendar Settings → Rentals → Global Settings → Notifications**
2. Select a notification type and open the **SMS tab**, then toggle SMS on
3. Choose your recipients (Contact, Business, or both)
4. Select or customize your SMS template
5. Send a test SMS to confirm the message looks right
6. Save — SMS will fire automatically when that event is triggered

updates.title: 💬 WhatsApp Notifications Are Here for Rentals
updates.content:
**WhatsApp Notifications Now Available for Rentals**

You can now send WhatsApp messages as part of your Rentals notification workflow — giving clients and your team a direct, mobile-first communication channel they're already using.

**What's new:**

- WhatsApp is supported across all rental event types: Unconfirmed, Booked, Canceled, Rescheduled, Reminder, and Follow-up
- Toggle WhatsApp on or off per individual notification type
- Choose recipients separately — send to Contacts, your Business, or both
- Set different WhatsApp templates per recipient type for full message control
- Each notification comes with a default template; keep it, select an existing approved template, or build a new one using the in-app template builder
- Refresh your available templates in real time with a single click
- Preview any message before it goes live using the test notification option

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Calendar Settings → Rentals → Global Settings → Notifications**
2. Under each notification type, toggle **WhatsApp** on
3. Select your recipients (Contacts, Business, or both)
4. Choose an approved WhatsApp template or create a new one using the template builder
5. Send a test message to confirm it looks right
6. Save — WhatsApp messages will now send automatically based on booking activity

updates.title: Prospecting: Smarter CRM contact creation & contact enrichment
updates.content:
**Prospecting: Smarter Contact Creation & Enrichment**

Kayan's Prospecting tool now creates richer, cleaner CRM contacts the moment you add a prospect — no manual cleanup required, and ready for outreach or automation from day one.

**What's new:**

- **Website-based enrichment** — Kayan now scrapes phone numbers and emails directly from a prospect's website, going beyond basic directory data so your CRM records start more complete
- **Fuller contact records by default** — Every new prospect contact now includes source tagging, prospect tags for segmentation, phone and email fields (including additional numbers/addresses), website URL, and full address details
- **Control over decision-maker contacts** — A new enrichment setting lets you choose whether Kayan should search for additional Points of Contact (POCs) like owners, managers, or key decision-makers. When enabled, each POC is created as its own CRM contact. When disabled, only the primary business contact is created — faster and cleaner for simpler workflows
- **No more duplicate business contacts** — Additional phone numbers and emails are now consolidated onto a single primary business contact rather than generating separate duplicate records. POCs are still created individually when found

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to the **Prospecting** section
2. Go to **Prospecting Settings** and locate the **Contact Enrichment** options
3. Toggle **POC search** on or off depending on whether you want decision-maker contacts created automatically
4. Run or re-run a prospect search — new contacts will be created with the enriched fields applied automatically
5. Find all created contacts in your **CRM tab**, filterable by the "Prospecting" source tag

updates.title: AI Studio Form Submitted Workflow Trigger
updates.content:
**AI Studio Form Submitted — Workflow Trigger**

Automate follow-up the moment a visitor submits a form on your AI Studio site. This new trigger connects AI Studio form submissions directly to Kayan Automations, so you can act on leads instantly without manual steps.

**What's new:**
- New "AI Studio Form Submitted" trigger available in Kayan Automations
- Automatically starts a workflow when a connected AI Studio form is submitted
- Supports any follow-up action: notifications, emails, SMS, tags, opportunity creation, and more
- Works alongside existing external tracking — no disruption to current setups

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan Automations** tab and create or edit a workflow
2. Add the **AI Studio Form Submitted** trigger
3. Connect your desired follow-up actions (email, SMS, tag, etc.)
4. Save and publish the workflow

**If your form was connected before this update**, you'll need to refresh the tracking setup:
1. Open the relevant AI Studio project
2. Prompt AI Studio: *"Re-trigger form integration"*
3. Reconnect the form to CRM tracking
4. Publish the project
5. Submit a test entry, then return to the workflow builder to confirm the trigger is firing correctly

updates.title: Prompt Optimizer for Conversations AI - Test, Tune, and Launch Better Chat Agents
updates.content:
**Prompt Optimizer for Chat Agents — Test, Tune, and Deploy with Confidence**

Before your chat agent goes live with real customers, now you can verify it actually performs the way you intend. Prompt Optimizer now supports Kayan's Conversations AI agents — running real test conversations, scoring results, and rewriting underperforming prompts, all without touching your live agent.

**What's new:**

- **Auto-generated test scenarios** — Kayan generates realistic customer personas, opening messages, expected behaviors, and priority levels based on your agent's prompt, language, knowledge base, and configured actions
- **Real conversations, not simulations** — the optimizer sends actual customer-style messages to a cloned copy of your agent and captures real replies
- **Action tracking** — see exactly when your agent triggers appointment booking, human handover, workflow actions, bot transfers, contact field updates, and knowledge base queries
- **Full transcripts with AI scoring** — every conversation is evaluated against expected outcomes with clear pass/fail reasoning
- **One-click Improvise** — AI identifies what failed, rewrites the prompt, and retests automatically
- **Auto Optimize** — runs multiple optimization rounds until a target accuracy threshold is reached
- **Prompt diff viewer** — review exactly what changed between versions before applying anything
- **Best Variation tag** — the highest-accuracy prompt is flagged, with full attempt history saved
- **Runs in the background** — start a test run and return when results are ready
- **Clean CRM** — temporary test contacts are created per run and automatically removed when complete
- **Multi-language support** — scenarios, evaluations, and optimized prompts stay aligned to your agent's configured language

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, open the Chat Agents section and select the agent you want to test
2. Navigate to the **Prompt Optimizer** tab within that agent's settings
3. Review the pre-run checklist — confirm your test calendars and workflows are in place, since real actions execute during testing
4. Choose to auto-generate new scenarios or load scenarios from a previous run
5. Start the test — the optimizer will run conversations against a cloned version of your agent; your live agent remains unchanged
6. Review transcripts, scores, and the prompt diff once the run completes
7. When satisfied with a variation, click **Use Prompt** to apply it to your live agent

> **Note:** Accuracy scores are directional — expect some variation between runs. Always use dedicated test calendars and workflows to avoid unintended bookings or workflow triggers during optimization.

updates.title: 💬Threads Comment Management: Now Available in Social Planner
updates.content:
**Threads Comment Management Now Available in Social Planner**

You can now manage Threads comments directly inside Kayan's Social Planner — no platform switching required. View, reply to, and track Threads conversations from the same unified inbox you use for all your other social channels.

**What's new**

- **Threads added to the unified inbox** — Threads now sits alongside Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Communities, and Bluesky in a single comment management view
- **Full reply support** — respond to Threads comments with text, images, emojis, and location attachments
- **Real-time sync** — comments update via webhooks so you're always seeing the latest activity
- **No workflow interruptions** — everything lives inside Social Planner; no need to leave Kayan to stay on top of Threads engagement

**How to set it up**

1. In the Kayan dashboard, go to **Marketing → Social Planner → Comment Management**
2. Select your connected Threads account
3. Open the **Comments** tab to view and reply to comments from the unified inbox

> **Note:** Existing Threads users will need to reconnect their account once to grant the additional permissions required for Comment Management.

updates.title: Email AI – Smart Countdown Timer Creation and Suggestions
updates.content:
**Email AI: Smart Countdown Timer Creation and Suggestions**

Kayan's Email AI now detects when an email calls for a countdown timer and guides you through adding one — no manual setup required.

**What's new:**
- Email AI identifies time-sensitive emails (flash sales, product launches, webinars, expiring offers) and suggests a countdown timer only when relevant
- Choose from an existing timer or create a new one directly within the AI flow
- When creating a new timer, AI collects the end date, style, and destination link automatically
- The selected timer is embedded into your email template on the spot
- If you skip the timer prompt, the AI continues without interruption — no dead ends

**How to set it up:**
1. Open the **Email Builder** from your Kayan dashboard and start a new template or edit an existing one
2. Activate **Email AI** to generate or update your layout
3. If your email content is time-sensitive, AI will prompt you to add a countdown timer — select an existing one or choose to create new
4. Provide the end date, preferred style, and a destination link when creating a new timer
5. Confirm, and the timer is embedded directly into your email — ready to send

updates.title: 🔐 Control Google Sign-In on Your Client Portal
updates.content:
**Control Google Sign-In on Your Client Portal**

You can now choose whether the "Sign in with Google" button appears on your Client Portal login and sign-up pages — giving you direct control over authentication options to meet compliance or data-handling requirements (including GDPR).

**What's new:**
- **Google Sign-In toggle** — Show or hide the Google login button on your portal's sign-up and login pages
- **Self-serve control** — Manage this setting directly from your portal permissions; no support request needed
- **Compliance-ready** — Remove third-party sign-in to align with regional privacy regulations such as GDPR
- When Google Sign-In is disabled, contacts authenticate via email + password or a secure login code

**How to set it up:**
1. In your Kayan dashboard, navigate to **Sites → Client Portal**
2. Open **App Permissions** and scroll to **Sign-up & sign-in methods**
3. Toggle **Disable Google sign-in & sign-up** on or off
4. Click **Save Settings**

updates.title: 🚀 New Communities Triggers in Workflows: Automate More, Faster
updates.content:
**4 New Community Triggers Now Live in Kayan Automations**

Automate responses to member activity inside your communities — without lifting a finger. Four new triggers are now available in Kayan Automations, letting you act instantly on group joins, posts, comments, and event registrations.

**What's new:**

- **Join Request Rejected** — Triggers when a member's request to join a group is declined. Filter by group.
- **Group Post Created** — Triggers when a new post is published in a group. Filter by group, channel, post title, or post content.
- **Group Comment Created** — Triggers when a comment is added to a group post. Filter by group, channel, post title, post content, or comment content.
- **Member Registered for Event** — Triggers when a member signs up for a group event. Filter by group or event title.

**How to set it up:**

1. Go to the **Automations** tab in your Kayan dashboard.
2. Create a new automation or open an existing one.
3. Click **Add Trigger** and search for "Community" to find the new options.
4. Select your trigger, set the required group filter, and add any optional filters to narrow targeting.
5. Configure your actions, save, and publish.

updates.title: RCS Messaging is Now Available in Workflows (Private Beta)

updates.title: Some email types are now exempted from DND
updates.content:
**Critical Emails Now Bypass DND Restrictions**

Certain time-sensitive emails will now reach contacts even when they're marked as Do Not Disturb (DND) — ensuring important operational communications are never silently dropped.

**What's changed:**
- **Payment emails** (invoices) are now delivered regardless of DND status
- **Calendar notifications** are no longer blocked by DND
- **System notifications** will always reach contacts as intended

**Why it matters:**
DND is designed to suppress marketing and promotional messages — not block invoices, appointment reminders, or system alerts. These three email types are transactional by nature, and failing to deliver them creates real operational problems for both you and your contacts. This update corrects that gap.

> **Note:** This is not a blanket DND override. All marketing and promotional emails continue to fully respect DND preferences. Only the three categories above are exempt.

---

**How to set it up**

No configuration needed — this is active automatically across your Kayan dashboard.

1. Open **Contacts** and locate any contact marked as DND
2. Confirm their DND status is set as usual — no changes required
3. Going forward, invoices, calendar notifications, and system emails will deliver to that contact without interruption

All other email types remain governed by your existing DND rules.

updates.title: 🤖 Ad Manager × Ask AI: Build & Manage Ad Campaigns
updates.content:
**Ad Manager + AI Assistant: Build and Manage Campaigns Through Conversation**

You can now create, manage, and analyze Meta and Google Ads campaigns directly through Kayan's AI Assistant — no manual screen-by-screen navigation required. Just describe what you want to do, and the AI handles the configuration.

**What's New**

- **Conversational campaign creation** — Describe your campaign goal and the AI collects requirements, configures supported settings, and builds a draft for your review before anything goes live. Supported types include Meta (Lead Generation, Website Traffic, Engagement, Sales) and Google (Search, Demand Gen)
- **Campaign management via chat** — List, filter, review, edit, clone, pause, resume, republish, or delete campaigns across Meta and Google. Confirmation is required before any destructive or publishing action
- **Audience creation and management** — Build and manage Meta audiences (custom, lookalike, website, Page engagement, lead form, Smart List) and Google audiences (Customer Match, website visitor, lookalike, interest, custom, Demand Gen segments) through natural conversation
- **Resource lookup built in** — The AI retrieves the supporting assets you need during setup: Meta Pages, Instagram accounts, pixels, lead forms, Google conversion actions, keywords, locations, languages, demographics, and more
- **Performance insights on demand** — Request performance data across campaigns, ad sets, ads, and keywords for any date range. Results are presented as summaries, metric breakdowns, trend graphs, or improvement suggestions
- **Account connection guidance** — The AI walks you through connecting and authorizing Meta and Google ad accounts within your existing permissions and access rules
- **Draft-first, approval-based publishing** — Campaigns are saved as drafts by default. Publishing, deleting, and account disconnections always require explicit user confirmation

**How to Set It Up**

1. Open the AI Assistant from your Kayan dashboard
2. Describe the advertising task you want to complete (e.g. *"Create a Meta lead generation campaign"* or *"Show my active Google campaigns"*)
3. Provide any additional details the AI requests
4. Review the generated draft or proposed action
5. Approve to publish or apply — nothing executes without your confirmation

**Notes**
- Supports Meta Ads and Google Ads; LinkedIn Ads are not included at this time
- All existing ad account permissions and platform compliance rules remain in effect
- Unsupported actions will redirect you to the relevant section of the Kayan Ad Manager

updates.title: Improved Abandoned Checkouts with Export, Filters & Notifications
updates.content:

The Abandoned Checkouts section has been redesigned with new tools to help you find, manage, and act on incomplete purchases faster.

**What's new:**
- **CSV Export** — Select one, several, or all records on the current page and export customer, cart, product, activity, and recovery details
- **Search & Filters** — Search by customer name or email, and filter by Email Status, Recovery Status, or Date Range
- **Notification Settings** — Access abandoned cart notification settings directly from the page via a new quick-access button
- **Shareable Recovery Links** — Open any abandoned checkout to copy and share its URL directly with the customer so they can return and complete their purchase
- **UI Improvements** — Refreshed empty states, loading states, pagination, and responsive layout throughout

**How to set it up:**

1. In your Kayan dashboard, go to **Payments → Orders → Abandoned Checkouts**
2. Use the search bar or **Add Filter** to narrow down records by customer, email status, recovery status, or date range
3. Select the records you want, then click **Export CSV** to download the data

**A few things to note:**

- "Select All" applies to the current page only

updates.title: 🚀 Multi-role signing for your Documents and Contracts templates, right inside Workflows.
updates.content:
**Multi-Role Signing for Documents & Contracts in Automations**

You can now define multiple signer roles directly on your document templates and route them automatically through Kayan Automations — no manual re-entry, no workarounds.

**What's new:**

- Add up to 6 signer roles per template (e.g. buyer, seller, witness, or any custom role you define)
- Assign fields — signature, date, and more — to each individual role
- When a document is sent via an Automation, all roles auto-populate based on your template setup
- Override any role's name, email, or phone at the automation level without editing the template
- One template can serve multiple deal types — just adjust role details per automation as needed
- If a required email is missing, you'll be prompted before the document goes out; duplicate emails across roles trigger an alert

**How to set it up:**

1. **Build your template** — Open your document template in the Kayan dashboard, define your signer roles (name, email, phone), and assign at least one fillable field to each role
2. **Assign a Contact field** — At least one fillable element must be assigned to the Contact role; this is required for the automation send action to work
3. **Add to your Automation** — In the Kayan Automations tab, add a Send Document action and select your multi-role template; roles will auto-populate
4. **Override if needed** — Adjust any role's details at the automation step level; these values take precedence over template defaults
5. **Activate** — Each signer receives their copy in the role and order you've defined

**Good to know:**
- Roles auto-populate only when sent via an Automation, not through manual send
- Role definitions are local to each individual template
- Available on web

updates.title: Client Portal — One Portal. Zero Tab-Hopping
updates.content:
**Client Portal — One Home for Everything**

Your client-facing portal is now a single, unified experience. Dashboard, Courses, Communities, Billing, Shared Files, Affiliates, and Account Settings all live under one roof — one login, one navigation, no tab-switching.

**What's new:**

- **Unified portal architecture** — Courses, Communities, and the Client Portal now share a common foundation. Features and user flows work across all of them seamlessly, with no product boundaries getting in the way.
- **Redesigned Dashboard** — Clients land on a real launchpad: courses in progress, community activity, pending invoices, recently shared files, and pinned communities all surface immediately. Content loads in ~0.4s and becomes interactive roughly a second sooner than before.
- **Business tools in the portal** — Invoices, estimates, contracts, shared files, and affiliate access are all reachable without leaving the experience.
- **Redesigned Communities UI** — Discussions, events, leaderboards, member directories, and community content are now part of the unified portal. Cleaner interface, consistent navigation, no separate app.
- **Connected Course experience** — Clients can discover courses, track progress, and move between lessons while staying inside the same branded environment.
- **Smoother transitions** — Polished page-change animations and faster load times across desktop and mobile.
- **SEO-ready public pages** — Public Course and Community pages now have search-friendly rendering, crawlable URLs, and page metadata. Lighthouse SEO scores of 92–100, up from 75–85. Private and gated content stays protected.

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open your **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to **Sites → Client Portal**.
2. Review your portal sections — Dashboard, Courses, Communities, Billing, Shared Files, and Affiliates should all appear within the unified navigation automatically.
3. Go to **Branding settings** within the portal to confirm your logo, colors, and domain are applied consistently across all sections.
4. Check any public Course or Community pages and verify metadata is configured under each item's settings to take advantage of the SEO improvements.
5. Share the portal login link with your clients — they'll land on the redesigned Dashboard and have access to everything from one place.

updates.title: 🎉 Smarter Drip Campaigns with Review Date Range Targeting
updates.content:
**Smarter Drip Campaigns with Review Date Range Targeting**

You can now target reviews by an exact date range when setting up a drip campaign — no more relying solely on a fixed review age window.

updates.title: Enhanced Sell Products Experience in Forms & Surveys

updates.title: Generate Submission Documents - Forms, Surveys & Quizzes

- Documents can be viewed, downloaded, and used across contact workflows
- Works across desktop and mobile
- Only new submissions are affected — existing submissions are not retroactively converted

1. In your Kayan dashboard, navigate to **Forms**, **Surveys**, or **Quizzes** and open the item you want to configure
2. Go to its **Settings** panel and locate the **Generate Submission Document** toggle
3. Switch it **on** and save
4. From that point forward, every new submission will generate and store a PDF automatically — accessible from the contact's **Documents** section

updates.title: ✏️ Fully Edit Service Bookings—Even After Payment

updates.title: Callers now hear their own country's ringtone
updates.content:
**Callers Now Hear a Familiar Ringtone, Wherever They Are**

When a call was forwarded, routed through an IVR, or transferred via Voice AI, callers outside the US were hearing a US-style ringback tone. That mismatch made calls feel off — sometimes enough to cause hang-ups before anyone answered.

Ringback tones are now localized to match the country of the phone number involved, across 37 countries.

**What's changed:**
- Inbound call forwarding plays the caller's local ringback tone
- Outbound calls use the local tone for the destination country
- IVR call routing respects the caller's regional tone
- Voice AI transfers play the correct tone for the country involved

**How to set it up:**

No configuration needed — this applies automatically based on the phone numbers in use. To confirm your numbers are set up correctly:

1. Go to your **Kayan dashboard** and open **Settings → Phone Numbers**
2. Verify that each number is assigned to the correct country
3. Make a test call to confirm the ringback tone matches what callers in that country expect

If a number is misconfigured to the wrong country, update it here and the correct tone will apply immediately.

updates.title: Single Page Unpublish for Funnels and Websites
updates.content:
**Single Page Unpublish for Funnels and Websites**

You can now take individual pages offline without touching the rest of your site. Hide outdated content, pause seasonal promotions, or manage campaigns granularly — all without disconnecting your domain or deleting a page permanently.

**What's new**

- **Granular page control:** Publish or unpublish a single funnel or website page while everything else stays live. The option is available directly from each page's actions menu — in both the page list and the builder's side panel.
- **Full page management inside the builder:** The side panel now includes a complete actions menu per page — Edit (rename/change URL slug), Preview, Clone, Publish, Unpublish, Edit Redirect Link, and Delete. The menu adapts based on the page's current state.
- **Built-in redirects:** When unpublishing, choose what visitors see at the old URL — a 404, a redirect to another page in the same funnel/website, or any external URL.
- **Editable redirects anytime:** Already unpublished a page? Update where its traffic goes at any time via Edit Redirect Link, without changing the page's publish state.
- **Status visibility everywhere:** Unpublished pages display a clear tag in the page list and sidebar. The builder header shows a live status chip (• Live / • Unpublished), the page's URL, and who last changed its status.
- **A/B test handling:** Unpublishing a page with an active A/B test automatically stops the test — all historical metrics are preserved.
- **Instant effect:** Status changes take effect immediately. No full-funnel republish needed.
- **Zero domain disruption:** Unpublishing a page does not affect your domain's SSL certificate or DNS settings.
- **Team accountability:** Every publish/unpublish action logs who made the change and when.

---

**How to set it up**

1. Open the funnel or website you want to manage in your Kayan dashboard and navigate to its page list.
2. Find the page you want to take offline and open its **Options** menu.
3. Select **Unpublish**. A confirmation dialog will appear explaining exactly what will and won't be affected.
4. Choose your redirect behavior: standard 404, redirect to another page in the same funnel/website, or redirect to a custom external URL.
5. Confirm. The page goes offline immediately — all other published pages are unaffected.
6. To update the redirect destination later, open the page's Options menu and select **Edit Redirect Link**.
7. To bring the page back, select **Publish** from the same menu — it goes live instantly.
8. Everything above is also accessible from the pages side panel inside the builder — no need to leave the canvas.

- **Map Custom Values before publishing** — A dedicated mapping step lets you review and fill in any missing values before the campaign goes live
- **Resolved preview** — Preview and review screens now display the final rendered copy so you can confirm exactly what will appear in the published ad
- **Validation alerts** — Kayan will flag missing, empty, invalid, or character-limit-exceeding values before you publish, reducing the risk of errors
- **Reusable templates** — Campaign templates retain Custom Value keys, making it straightforward to reuse one template across multiple clients by mapping new values at launch

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Ad Manager** in your Kayan dashboard
2. Create or edit a Meta, Google, or LinkedIn campaign
3. Navigate to the ad copy section
4. Click the **Insert Custom Values** icon next to a supported copy field
5. Search for and select the value you want to use
6. Repeat across any additional copy fields as needed
7. Click **Map Custom Values** to review or fill in any outstanding values
8. Check the preview screen to confirm the resolved copy looks correct
9. Clear any validation warnings, then publish

**Notes:**
- Custom Values are supported in copy fields only — not in URLs, CTA dropdowns, media uploads, targeting, or budget/bid fields
- Campaigns can be saved as drafts with unresolved values
- Updating a Custom Value after a campaign is live will not automatically update running ads — changes require a republish

updates.title: Tags for Courses

updates.title: Client Portal - Shared File Notifications for Clients
updates.content:
**Client Portal – File Share Notifications**

Clients now get notified the moment you share a file with them through the Kayan Client Portal — no more chasing people down to let them know a document is waiting.

- Push notifications are supported on both the web portal and the Kayan mobile app

2. Goes to **Settings → Notification Preferences**
3. Toggles In-app and/or Push notifications for file shares on or off
4. Saves preferences

updates.title: Version History in AI Builder
updates.content:
**Version History in AI Workflow Builder**

Every AI-generated iteration of your workflow is now tracked and restorable — no more rebuilding from scratch if an AI edit goes wrong.

**What's new:**

- **Artifact card per iteration** — each AI build or edit produces an inline card in the chat at the exact point the change was made
- **Active version indicator** — the card matching your current canvas state gets a purple border so you always know where you are
- **One-click restore** — open the three-dot menu on any older card and select "Restore this version" to revert the canvas instantly
- **Non-destructive navigation** — restoring an older version keeps all newer ones intact; move between iterations freely without losing anything
- **Unsaved pill** — when auto-save is off, cards display an "Unsaved" indicator until the workflow is saved manually; the pill disappears when auto-save is on
- **Unified version timeline** — AI iterations and manual edits appear together in a single Version History, keeping one authoritative source of truth

**How to set it up:**

1. Open your workflow in the Kayan Automations tab and launch the AI Assistant
2. Prompt it to build or edit your workflow — an artifact card appears in chat with a purple border marking it as the active version
3. Prompt another change; the new card takes the purple border and the previous card gains a three-dot menu with "Restore this version"
4. To restore any prior iteration, open its three-dot menu and select "Restore this version" — the canvas updates immediately
5. To view the full timeline, select "Show in version history" from the three-dot menu to open the Version History tab

updates.title: "Explain This Workflow" discovery pill in Snapshot imported workflows
updates.content:
**"Explain This Automation" — Instant Context on Imported Workflows**

Workflows brought in through a template import now surface an "Explain This Automation" pill at the top of the builder. One click opens the AI Assistant with a full breakdown of exactly what that workflow does.

**What's new:**
- **"Explain This Automation" pill** — Appears automatically at the top of any workflow imported via template
- **One-click breakdown** — Opens the AI Assistant with a complete explanation of the workflow's triggers, actions, and branching logic
- **Dismissible** — Dismiss it once and it won't reappear on that workflow

**How to set it up:**

1. Open any workflow you've imported through a Kayan template
2. Click the **"Explain This Automation"** pill at the top of the Kayan Automations builder
3. Review the full breakdown in the AI Assistant panel
4. Ask follow-up questions about specific steps, or describe the changes you want — the AI Builder can apply them directly

Inherited workflows come with no built-in context. This closes that gap at the moment it matters most — right when you open it — and connects you directly into the AI Assistant and AI Builder to understand, question, and edit without leaving the builder.

updates.title: Hover Animations for Buttons
updates.content:
**Hover Animations for Buttons**

Buttons in the Kayan page builder now support dynamic hover effects — no custom CSS required. Choose from 21 built-in animations and fine-tune every parameter directly from the sidebar.

**What's new:**

- **21 hover effects** organized into six categories:
  - *Scale:* Grow, Shrink, Pulse, Bounce In
  - *Rotation:* Rotate, Skew Forward
  - *Movement:* Float, Wobble Horizontal, Buzz
  - *Background:* Fade, Sweep To Right, Sweep To Bottom, Radial In, Bounce To Top
  - *Border:* Ripple Out, Outline In, Underline From Center
  - *Shadow:* Shadow, Glow, Box Shadow Outset
- **Live canvas preview** — hover over any effect card in the sidebar to see it on your button before applying it
- **Contextual controls** — each effect surfaces only the settings relevant to it: scale factor, rotation angle, movement distance, fill/border color, shadow blur and spread, plus universal timing controls (duration, delay, easing)
- **Mobile-safe** — hover states automatically disable on touch devices and screens under 1024px
- **Entrance animation sequencing** — if a button has an entrance animation, the hover effect waits until it completes before activating
- **Replicated elements** — cloned buttons, sticky bar buttons, and nav duplicates automatically inherit hover behavior from the original

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan Page Builder** and select a button on the canvas.
2. In the sidebar, go to the **Animation** tab and select **Hover Animation**.
3. Hover over any effect card to preview it live on your button.
4. Click an effect to apply it.
5. Use the **Adjust** panel below the effect grid to fine-tune timing, color, scale, distance, or shadow settings as needed.

updates.title: Entrance Animations for Sections, Rows and Columns
updates.content:
**Entrance Animations Now Work on Sections, Rows, and Columns**

You can now apply entrance animations directly to layout blocks — not just individual elements. The page builder automatically sequences animations in hierarchy as visitors scroll, so your pages reveal cleanly without manual timing work.

**What's new:**

- **Layout-level animation support** — apply entrance animations to full Sections, Rows, and Columns
- **Expanded animation library** — new and updated options across Fade, Slide, Bounce, Flip, Rotate & Zoom, and Special Effects (including infinite loops like Glow, Rocking, and Bounce)
- **Custom tuning controls** — set Duration (0.1s–3s), Delay (0s–5s), Scale (0.5×–2×), and Easing (Linear, Ease-in, Ease-out, Ease-in-out)
- **Live hover previews** — hover any animation option in the sidebar to preview it on your selected block before applying
- **Automatic sequencing** — animations fire in order (Section → Row → Column → Content); each child waits for its parent to finish
- **Mobile control** — animations are off on mobile by default; enable per block with the new **Enable animations on mobile** toggle, and remaining blocks auto-sequence around any disabled ones
- **Backward compatible** — existing published pages automatically inherit the updated sequencing logic with no re-save required

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the Kayan page builder and select any Section, Row, or Column on the canvas
2. In the sidebar, open the **Animations** tab and choose **Entrance Animation**
3. Hover over any animation option to preview it live on your selected block
4. Click to apply your chosen animation style
5. Adjust Duration, Delay, Scale, and Easing to fine-tune the effect
6. Optionally toggle **Enable animations on mobile** if you want the animation active on mobile devices

updates.title: Hover animations for button in Highlevel Funnel and Website builder
updates.content:
**Hover Animations for Buttons in the Page Builder**

Add interactive hover effects to any button in your funnels or websites — no CSS required.

**What's new:**

- 20 hover effects to choose from: Grow, Shrink, Pulse, Bounce In, Rotate, Float, Skew Forward, Wobble Horizontal, Buzz, Fade, Sweep To Right, Sweep To Bottom, Radial In, Bounce To Top, Ripple Out, Outline In, Underline From Center, Shadow, Glow, and Box Shadow Outset
- Live preview on the canvas — hover an effect card and it plays on your selected button instantly, so you can compare before committing
- Every effect exposes Duration (0.1–3s), Delay (0–5s), and Easing controls, plus only the additional settings relevant to that specific effect:
  - **Scale effects** (Grow, Shrink, Pulse, Bounce In) → Scale (0.5×–2×)
  - **Rotation effects** (Rotate, Skew Forward) → Angle (−180° to 180°)
  - **Movement effects** (Float, Wobble Horizontal, Buzz) → Distance (0–50)
  - **Background effects** (Fade, Sweep To Right, Sweep To Bottom, Radial In, Bounce To Top) → Fill Colour
  - **Border effects** (Ripple Out, Outline In, Underline From Center) → Border Colour, Thickness (1–10px)
  - **Shadow effects** (Shadow, Glow, Box Shadow Outset) → Shadow Colour, Blur (0–50px), Spread (0–50px)
- Every effect ships with sensible defaults — looks right immediately, adjusting is optional
- Hover is automatically disabled on touch devices and screens under 1024px, preventing stuck hover states on mobile
- If a button has an entrance animation, hover activation waits until that entrance completes
- Buttons used multiple times on a page (sticky bars, nav clones) animate consistently with the original
- Entrance animations are now steadier overall — they no longer replay on drag, device switch, or component remount, and only trigger once the element is visible on screen

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the Kayan Page Builder and select a button on the canvas
2. In the sidebar, go to the **Animation** tab and select **Hover Animation**
3. Pick an effect from the grid — it previews live on your button
4. Once selected, the **Adjust** panel below the grid shows the controls specific to that effect
5. Set your Duration, Delay, and Easing as needed, then publish

updates.title: ✨ Ask AI in Mobile App Can Now Read Your Files ✨
updates.content:
**AI Assistant on Mobile Now Reads Your Files**

The AI Assistant in the Kayan mobile app now accepts images and documents directly in the chat. Attach a file, ask your question, and get answers based on your actual content — no retyping required.

**What's new:**
- Tap the attachment icon in the chat composer to upload from your Camera, Gallery, device Files, or your Kayan Media Library
- Files upload in the background while you continue typing
- Attached files appear as a preview chip in the composer before you send

updates.title: Redeeming Gift Cards in Offline Payment Flows
updates.content:
**Gift Card Redemption Now Available in Business-Initiated Payment Flows**

You can now apply a customer's Gift Card balance when collecting payments on their behalf — not just on customer-facing checkouts. This brings a consistent redemption experience across every payment flow in Kayan.

**What's new:**

- Gift Card redemption is now supported when recording or collecting payments directly from your dashboard
- Applies across orders, invoices, direct charges, and new subscriptions
- If the Gift Card covers the full amount, no other payment method is charged
- If the balance is partial, the Gift Card is applied first and the remainder is automatically charged to the customer's saved payment method
- Validation messages surface for invalid, expired, or zero-balance Gift Cards
- Transaction details clearly show the Gift Card amount redeemed
- Split payments display the Gift Card and remaining charge separately
- The Gift Card's remaining balance updates automatically after each successful redemption

> **Note:** Gift Card redemption on future-dated or scheduled subscriptions is not yet supported — that's coming soon.

---

**How to set it up:**

1. Navigate to the relevant payment flow in your Kayan dashboard:
   - **Payments → Orders → Record Payment**
   - **Payments → Invoices → Record Payment**
   - **Contacts → Charge Now**
   - **Contacts → Create Subscription**
   - **Payments → Subscriptions → Create Subscription**
2. During the payment process, enter the customer's Gift Card code in the Gift Card field
3. Click **Apply** to validate and apply the available balance
4. Complete the payment — any remaining balance will charge to the customer's saved payment method automatically

updates.title: Schema markup auto-generation on Website, Funnel & Webinar publish
updates.content:
**Auto-Generate Schema Markup on Page Publish**

Kayan now automatically generates schema markup for any page published without it — across Websites, Funnels, and Webinars. No more missing structured data because a step got skipped.

**What's new:**

- When enabled, Kayan's AI generates schema markup in the background the moment a page is published without existing schema
- Publishing speed is unaffected — generation runs in parallel and never delays the page going live
- Existing schema is never touched or overwritten
- Works across all publish methods: manual publish, save-triggered publish, and version-history publish
- Applies to Websites, Funnels, and Webinars
- New assets default to **ON**; existing assets default to **OFF** — nothing changes on your current pages unless you switch it on

**Why it matters:**

Schema markup drives rich results in Google and helps AI answer engines understand and cite your content. Auto-generation ensures every published page carries structured data by default, protecting your SEO and AI search visibility without any manual effort.

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the Kayan dashboard and navigate to your Website, Funnel, or Webinar
2. Go to **Settings**, then select the **SEO & AEO** section
3. Toggle **Auto-generate schema** on or off per asset
4. Hit **Save**

That's it. Kayan handles the rest at publish time.

updates.title: Save Progress - Forms, Surveys & Quizzes
updates.content:
**Save Progress for Forms, Surveys & Quizzes**

Respondents can now leave a multi-step form, survey, or quiz mid-way and pick up exactly where they left off — no lost answers, no starting over.

**What's new:**
- A **Save Exit Confirmation** toggle is available in the Settings tab for all Forms, Surveys, and Quizzes
- When enabled, progress is automatically saved if a respondent closes the browser, refreshes, or navigates away before submitting
- On return, a **Resume Progress modal** appears giving respondents the choice to continue where they left off or start fresh
- The Resume modal automatically inherits your form's branding — button color matches your footer color, font matches your label font
- Fully supported on desktop and mobile
- Existing forms are unaffected until you explicitly enable the toggle

**How to set it up:**

1. Open the **Kayan dashboard** and navigate to your Forms, Surveys, or Quizzes builder
2. Select the form you want to update and open its **Settings** tab
3. Enable the **Save Exit Confirmation** toggle
4. Save your changes — progress saving is now active for that form

No additional configuration required. The resume experience is handled automatically for your respondents.

updates.title: Automatically Associate CRM Records with Workflows
updates.content:
**Automatically Associate CRM Records via Workflows** *(Coming Soon)*

A new workflow action is on the way that will let Kayan automatically link related CRM records based on matching field values — no manual association required.

**What's coming:**
- A dedicated **Associate Records** action for Contact, Company, and Custom Object workflows
- Filter-based record matching using one or more field conditions
- Support for merge fields from the enrolled record as filter values
- Flexible match handling — associate the earliest created, latest created, or all matching records
- Ability to apply existing association labels when linking records
- Works across Contacts, Companies, Opportunities, and Custom Objects

**Example use case:** A real estate team could automatically link a buyer contact to property records that match their preferred city, type, and bedroom count — all without touching a single record manually.

This is currently in development. Once live, it will be available directly within the Kayan Automations builder.

updates.title: Separate email templates for Badges
updates.content:
**Separate Email Templates for Welcome Badges**

Welcome Badge emails can now be customized independently from standard Badge Issued emails — so your enrollment-triggered messaging stays distinct without affecting other badge notifications.

**What's new:**
- New **Welcome Badge Issued** notification type, separate from the existing Badge Issued type
- Dedicated email template for welcome badge emails in your portal email settings
- Cleaner separation between Certificate, Badge, and Welcome Badge email configurations
- Enrollment-triggered welcome badges automatically route through the Welcome Badge Issued path

**How to set it up:**
1. Go to your **Kayan dashboard** and open **Client Portal → Email Settings**
2. Locate **Welcome Badge Issued** listed alongside Badge Issued and Certificate Issued
